meta.name: add-mattermost
meta.description: Add a self-hosted or cloud Mattermost bot channel through the Chat SDK bridge, reusing a healthy server when available and linking to official server setup guidance when needed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 Mattermost 机器人接进聊天频道,复用可用服务器并给出搭建指引
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你团队用 Mattermost,想让机器人常驻聊天频道。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team runs Mattermost and wants a bot living in its channels.

howto.what: 它给 Claude 接入一个 Mattermost 机器人频道:能收发私聊、频道消息、话题、文件与表情回应,并处理审批卡片。它会先探测你已有的服务器或让你填地址,再配置机器人令牌和回调,最后构建、测试并重启 NanoClaw。
howto.when: 当你要求给 Claude 添加 Mattermost 频道时接管。它会先查环境里的 MATTERMOST_BASE_URL、探测本地 8065 端口和 Docker 容器,再让你决定复用还是另填地址。

say.text: 帮我接入 Mattermost,先看看有没有能用的服务器
say.note: 它会探测并列出可复用的服务器让你选

say.text: 这是我的 Mattermost 机器人令牌,请存好
say.note: 会先用它认证机器人身份再保存

howto.what_en: Adds a Mattermost bot channel to Claude: DMs, messages, threads, files, reactions and approval cards. It finds or asks for a server URL, then saves the bot token and callback, builds, tests and restarts NanoClaw.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add a Mattermost channel to Claude. It checks MATTERMOST_BASE_URL, probes localhost:8065 and looks for Docker containers, then reuses one or asks for a URL.

say_en.text: Add Mattermost — first check if there's a healthy server I can reuse.
say_en.note: It probes and lists servers for you to pick

say_en.text: Use https://mm.example.com as my Mattermost server URL.
say_en.note: Validated and saved as the base URL

say_en.text: Here is my Mattermost bot token — please save it.
